description: Bus Stops (Metro, Night Rider, Regional and Coach) is a dataset listed in City of Casey's Open Data Portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by City of Casey. This dataset provides the location of the PTV Bus Stops (Metro, Night Rider, Regional and Coach) Services within Casey and surrounding areas. It also provides Casey asset information for the Stops within the City of Casey. Coverage: City of Casey, Victoria. The portal files it under Community, Assets, Transport. Its keywords are Bus Routes, Bus Stop, Transport, PTV. The portal shows 4,133 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-05-05 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 3. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-casey-vic-gov-au-portal.
